overview_description.description:
Sarus solves the access and sharing of personal data for analytics or machine learning. 
It deploys natively in data infrastructures and lets practitioners work on data they cannot see while protecting everything with the highest standard of privacy: differential privacy.
Sarus makes traditional anonymization methods irrelevant, saving months in compliance and data engineering while preserving all of the value of data.
Data practitioners no longer need to go through a process-heavy and value-impacting anonymization phase to start data projects and can leverage the full data with mathematical privacy guarantees in minutes. Sarus takes the data confidentiality risk out of collaboration projects across lines of business, geographic borders or with external partners.

product.name: Sarus Privacy Layer for Analytics & AI
product.description: A privacy layer that enables data scientists and analysts to query and analyze sensitive data without direct access, ensuring compliance and security through differential privacy and synthetic data.

product.name: SarusLLM
product.description: A privacy layer for large language models (LLMs) that enables safe fine-tuning and use of open-source LLMs without exposing sensitive data or embedding private information in model weights.

product.name: Qrlew
product.description: An open-source library that rewrites SQL queries into differentially private versions, enabling privacy-safe data analysis across various SQL dialects and databases.

product.name: Sarus Clean Rooms Differential Privacy
product.description: A managed solution that adds a differential privacy layer to cloud or on-premises data clean rooms, enabling privacy-safe SQL and AI analyses without exposing individual data.

product.name: Sarus Integration with MongoDB
product.description: A solution enabling privacy-safe AI and analytics on healthcare data stored in MongoDB, allowing researchers to query sensitive medical data without direct access.
